root:
Usage: backlog-mcp [options] [command]

Task management MCP server

Options:
  -V, --version                       output the version number
  --json                              Output as JSON
  --home <home>                       Backlog home: global, project, or all
                                      (read-only)
  --project-root <path>               Explicit project root for project home
  -h, --help                          display help for command

Commands:
  serve                               Run as HTTP MCP server with viewer
  status                              Check if server is running
  stop                                Stop the server
  list [options]                      List backlog items
  get [options] <ids...>              Get one or more items by ID
  create [options] <title>            Create a new backlog item
  update [options] <id>               Update a backlog item
  delete [options] <id>               Delete a backlog item
  search [options] <query>            Search backlog items
  edit                                Edit an item body (use a subcommand:
                                      replace, append, insert)
  wakeup [options]                    Session-start briefing (active tasks,
                                      epics, recent completions, activity)
  recall [options] <query...>         Recall memories — stubs by default; --full
                                      for bodies (durable MEMO- entities since
                                      ADR 0092.3)
  remember [options] <content...>     Write a durable memory — a fact,
                                      procedure, or preference (ADR 0092.3 Phase
                                      C)
  forget [options]                    Retract memories — soft-expire (drops from
                                      recall, stays auditable). --expired
                                      hard-deletes already-expired (GC).
  consolidation-candidates [options]  Clusters of episodic memories ripe for
                                      distillation into knowledge (ADR 0092.7)
  contradictions [options]            Live memories that share a state_key — the
                                      R-2 invariant breached, flagged for human
                                      adjudication (ADR 0092.13)
  migrate                             Run explicit one-shot backlog migrations
  version                             Show version
  help                                Show help

Stop the server

Options:

list:
Usage: backlog-mcp list [options]

List backlog items

Options:
  --status <status...>  Filter by status
  --type <type>         Filter by type
  --parent <id>         Filter by parent
  --query <text>        Search across fields
  --counts              Include counts
  --limit <n>           Max items
  -h, --help            display help for command
get:
Usage: backlog-mcp get [options] <ids...>

Get one or more items by ID

Options:
  --context   Expand each entity's relational neighborhood as stubs (ADR 0114) —
              parent/children/siblings/references/referenced_by/related; hydrate
              any stub with another get
  -h, --help  display help for command
create:
Usage: backlog-mcp create [options] <title>

Create a new backlog item

Options:
  --content <text>        Content in markdown
  --source <path>         Read content from file
  --type <type>           Substrate type
  --parent <id>           Parent ID
  --fields <json-object>  Low-level substrate-specific fields as a JSON object
  --as <agent>            Attribute this write to an agent identity — an AGENT-
                          doc id or declared principal (e.g. aime:granite).
                          Optional per-call override; usually implicit via git
                          config backlog.agent or BACKLOG_AGENT (ADR 0119.1)
  -h, --help              display help for command
update:
Usage: backlog-mcp update [options] <id>

Update a backlog item

Options:
  --title <text>              New title
  --status <status>           New status
  --parent <id>               Set parent (use "" to clear)
  --evidence <text...>        Evidence entries
  --blocked-reason <text...>  Blocked reasons
  --due-date <date>           Due date (use "" to clear)
  --fields <json-object>      Low-level substrate-specific fields as a JSON
                              object
  --as <agent>                Attribute this write to an agent identity — an
                              AGENT- doc id or declared principal (e.g.
                              aime:granite). Optional per-call override; usually
                              implicit via git config backlog.agent or
                              BACKLOG_AGENT (ADR 0119.1)
  -h, --help                  display help for command
delete:

  --as <agent>  Attribute this write to an agent identity — an AGENT- doc id or
                declared principal (e.g. aime:granite). Optional per-call
                override; usually implicit via git config backlog.agent or

wakeup:
Usage: backlog-mcp wakeup [options]

Session-start briefing (active tasks, epics, recent completions, activity)

Options:
  --scope <id>           Scope to a container entity (folder/milestone/epic)
  --operation <id>       Focus the briefing on one live operation document (its
                         declared projection becomes the centerpiece; non-focal
                         sections yield budget)
  --max-completions <n>  Max recent completions
  --max-activity <n>     Max recent activity entries
  --max-knowledge <n>    Max knowledge items (semantic/procedural memories)
  --max-constraints <n>  Max requirement constraint stubs (0 disables)
  --evidence-chars <n>   Max chars of evidence per completion
  -h, --help             display help for command
recall:
Usage: backlog-mcp recall [options] <query...>

Recall memories — stubs by default; --full for bodies (durable MEMO- entities
since ADR 0092.3)

Options:
  --context <id>     Scope to memories written with this entity as their context
                     (e.g. FLDR-0001)
  --tags <tags>      Comma-separated tag filter, any-match (e.g. exp-1,friction)
  --layers <layers>  Comma-separated layers; default: all persisted layers
  --limit <n>        Max results
  --full             Return full memory bodies instead of stubs
  --budget <tokens>  Approximate token budget — results packed to fit
  -h, --help         display help for command
remember:
Usage: backlog-mcp remember [options] <content...>

Write a durable memory — a fact, procedure, or preference (ADR 0092.3 Phase C)

Options:
  --title <title>      Memory title (required, like a task title)
  --layer <layer>      episodic | semantic (default) | procedural
  --context <id>       Scope container (e.g. FLDR-0001)
  --tags <tags>        Comma-separated labels (e.g. exp-1,friction)
  --refs <ids>         Comma-separated source entity ids (e.g.
                       TASK-0676,ADR-0027)
  --kind <kind>        current | historical | plan | preference | timeless
  --state-key <key>    Evolving-fact key — closes previous holders
  --occurred-at <iso>  When the event occurred (ISO date)
  --valid-until <iso>  Expiry (ISO date)
  --supersedes <id>    MEMO- id this memory replaces
  --derived            Mark as inference (consolidator output) — requires --refs
  --as <agent>         Attribute this memory to an agent identity — an AGENT-
                       doc id or declared principal (e.g. aime:granite).
                       Optional per-call override; usually implicit via git
                       config backlog.agent or BACKLOG_AGENT (ADR 0119.1)
  -h, --help           display help for command
forget:
Usage: backlog-mcp forget [options]

Retract memories — soft-expire (drops from recall, stays auditable). --expired
hard-deletes already-expired (GC).

Options:
  --ids <id...>       Specific MEMO- ids
  --context <id>      All memories scoped to this context
  --layer <layer>     episodic | semantic | procedural
  --older-than <iso>  Memories created before this ISO date
  --expired           GC: hard-delete already-expired memories
  -h, --help          display help for command
consolidation-candidates:
Usage: backlog-mcp consolidation-candidates [options]

Clusters of episodic memories ripe for distillation into knowledge (ADR 0092.7)

Options:
  --min-count <n>     Minimum bundle size to be ripe (default 3)
  --min-age-days <n>  Minimum age of the oldest member (default 7)
  --min-demand <n>    Recall-demand threshold for ripeness regardless of age
                      (default 3)
  --context <id>      Restrict to one context (e.g. FLDR-0001)
  --limit <n>         Max bundles (default 10)
  -h, --help          display help for command
contradictions:
Usage: backlog-mcp contradictions [options]

Live memories that share a state_key — the R-2 invariant breached, flagged for
human adjudication (ADR 0092.13)

Options:
  --candidates  List semantic collision candidates instead of structural
                state_key contradictions
  -h, --help    display help for command
